packages.title: On a timed task's own day, its plan rings at the task's usual reminder, in its words, and the task's line and the sheet say that time
brief: UX-2001 (S4), the owner's D1, as recommended (DECISIONS.md, 2026-10-22 evening; the contract's «Except on the day of a timed task (D1)»). Today a plan replaces its task's single reminder entirely (App/lib/services/reminder_engine.dart:288-297), and every plan notice, the day's own included, rings at `plan.time ?? «Tareas sin hora» ?? 9:00` (App/lib/services/reminder_plans.dart:41-42 and :64-81). So «Análisis de sangre» on Thu 12 Nov at 8:00 with Normal gets «Es hoy» at 9:00, an hour after, and nothing at 7:50; a 17:00 presentation gets 9:00 and nothing at 16:50, while Ajustes › Recordatorios promises «10 minutos antes». The rule now: when the plan's anchor (the deadline when there is one, else the task's day: `ReminderPlans.anchor`, :29) has a time (`deadlineHasTime` for a deadline, else `hasTime`), the day's own notice (daysBefore 0) rings at the single reminder's moment, in the single reminder's words, with its actions. Every earlier notice, and the last one the day after, keep the plan's time; the number of notices doesn't change. A date-only anchor is unchanged.

The moment. Add one helper to ReminderPlans, for example `static int? dayLead(Task task, int defaultLead)`: null when the anchor has no time; otherwise the first of these leads whose moment (the anchor's time minus the lead) still falls on the anchor's own calendar day: the task's own lead (`task.reminderMinutes`, when it's 0 or more), then Settings' «Tareas con hora» (`defaultLead`: ReminderPreferences.leadMinutes, 10 by default, -1 when it's off). Null when neither does (both off, or a lead that reaches the day before, such as «1 día antes», or a task at 0:05): the day's notice then keeps the plan's time, as today. Give `alerts` (:64-81) an optional named `int? dayLead`: when it's set, the alert with daysBefore 0 rings at `anchor.subtract(Duration(minutes: dayLead))` instead of `at(anchor, 0, minute)`; the other alerts, their order and the late one are unchanged. `taskAlerts` (:85-100) passes `dayLead(task, …)` with Settings' lead: give it a named parameter for that lead, and have every caller pass ReminderPreferences.leadMinutes (making it required is the simplest way to find them all).

The notice. `ReminderEngine.planReminders` (App/lib/services/reminder_engine.dart:165-193) passes `ReminderPlans.dayLead(task, preferences.leadMinutes)` to `alerts`. When the day's notice moves, its body is the single reminder's text for that anchor, as `ReminderCopy.body` (App/lib/services/reminder_copy.dart:102-134) writes it for a task whose reminder is about that anchor: build it from `task.copyWith(reminderAnchor: task.deadline != null ? 'deadline' : 'planned')`, at the moved time, with that lead. So ES «Hoy a las 17:00 · en 10 min», «Hoy a las 17:00 · en 1 h», «Hoy a las 8:00 · en 10 min» (the time as the app's clock writes it); CA «Avui a les 17:00 · d’aquí a 10 min»; EN “Today at 5:00 PM · in 10 min”; a deadline with a time «Fecha límite: hoy a las 17:00» / «Termini: avui a les 17:00» / “Deadline: today at 5:00 PM” (the single reminder's deadline text has no «en 10 min» tail). No new strings: these are notificationAt, notificationInMinutes, notificationInHours and notificationDeadlineAt. When the day's notice doesn't move, it keeps `planBody` («Es hoy a las 17:00»).

Its actions. It is the task's usual reminder, so it carries «Completar» and «Posponer 10 min» (CA «Completa», «Ajorna 10 min»; EN “Complete”, “Snooze 10 min”), and on iOS the `task_<lang>` category; every other plan notice keeps «Completar» only and `plan_<lang>` (UX-2009, App/lib/services/notification_service.dart:50-73). A snooze brings it back 10 minutes after the tap in the single reminder's snoozed words, with no lead: «Hoy a las 17:00» (the snooze path, reminder_engine.dart:404-436, rebuilds every plan notice with `planBody` today). In every other way it stays a plan notice: one per task in the shade (UX-2004, :468-500), cancelled when the task is completed and back with «Deshacer», moved with the day, and checked by `_currentTask` (:623-655) against the anchor. A simple way to keep every rebuilt copy right (scheduled, snoozed, shown again by «Deshacer») is to give it its own identity, still a plan alert, for example `planIdentity(...)` plus `/time`, with a helper the notification details and the snooze path read, and to make `_planDaysBefore` (:153-159) parse only the date part. Choose what's simplest, and say what you chose in your notes.

The words follow the same moment, with no new copy. `planRhythm`, `planLine` and `planCount` (App/lib/l10n/reminder_plan_words.dart:32-54, :90-129, :133-151) take an optional `int? dayLead` and pass it to `ReminderPlans.alerts` (`planRhythm`'s `ahead`, :43-45, counts the day's notice at its moved time). Callers: in App/lib/widgets/reminder_control.dart, `reminderPlanText` (:87-106) and `_alertPassed` (:57-81) use `ReminderPlans.dayLead(task, <Settings' lead>)`, with ReminderPreferences' default (10) while Settings load; `ReminderEngine.alertAhead` (:251-275) passes Settings' lead to `taskAlerts`. In App/lib/widgets/reminder_plan_sheet.dart, build (:451-458) computes the lead once from `widget.task` (the task as it would be saved, with its current minutes) and Settings, and passes it to the three PlanPreviews (:561, :616, :706) and to the dictated row's `planRhythm` (:595-601); PlanPreview (:756-849) takes it and gives it to its `alerts` (:775-783), `planRhythm` (:789) and `planCount` (:833-841). So on the task's own day at 10:00, with the task at 17:00 and Normal, the task's chip, the form's line and the capture card read «Recordatorios normales hasta hoy · próximo: hoy, 16:50» where they read «Sin recordatorio: ya ha pasado la hora del aviso» after 9:00 today, and the sheet's count reads «1 aviso: hoy, 16:50»; after 16:50 they read the passed text, as UX-1804 does.

Don't touch: the strengths' phases (App/lib/models/reminder_plan.dart: P253 changes them in this wave), the offer (App/lib/widgets/reminder_ask_sheet.dart: P255 and P256; it calls `planRhythm` without the lead, which is right for a task 14 or more days away), the capture card, ARB files, date-only anchors (their day's notice stays «Es hoy» at the plan's time), the last notice («Era para ayer», «Venció ayer», at the plan's time), the single reminder of tasks without a plan, and `ReminderPlans.offerable`. A plan with a time of its own is moved too on that day, as D1 is worded; whether a time said for the day itself should win is the owner's open D8 (UX-2022), so don't add that exception.

Tests: date-only plans behave as before, so the engine's tests about them stand (App/test/reminder_plan_engine_test.dart:92-125 and the rest). Calls of `ReminderPlans.taskAlerts` in tests (for example App/test/reminder_plans_test.dart, about :572-597) need Settings' lead passed, and nothing else; say so in your notes. Preview: add `reminders/task-line.timed-today` (es 1×, es 2×) right after the `task-line.own-words` block in App/test/ux_previews/reminders_previews.dart: a task today at 17:00 with Normal, at the previews' 9:41: «Recordatorios normales hasta hoy · próximo: hoy, 16:50», described so. P253, P254 and P256 add theirs at other places in that file. The contract already states D1 but not the notice's «Posponer 10 min»: a note for the main session.
acceptance: Engine (App/test/reminder_plan_engine_test.dart's harness: Thu 22 Oct 2026 10:00, Spanish, reminders on, «Tareas sin hora» 9:00, «Tareas con hora» 10 minutes): «Presentar el proyecto» on Fri 13 Nov 2026 at 17:00 with Normal sets 24, 27 and 30 Oct and 2 Nov at 9:00, Thu 12 Nov at 9:00 «Es mañana a las 17:00», Fri 13 Nov at 16:50 «Hoy a las 17:00 · en 10 min», and Sat 14 Nov at 9:00 «Era para ayer»; nothing on Fri 13 Nov at 9:00; and `ReminderPlans.taskAlerts(…, late: false)` with Settings' lead counts 13, as for the same task without a time.

reminderNotificationDetails: the day's notice of the timed task has the Android actions `complete` and `snooze` and the iOS category `task_es`; its Thu 12 Nov and Sat 24 Oct notices have only `complete` and `plan_es`. Snoozing the day's notice brings it back 10 minutes after the tap, reading «Hoy a las 17:00».

Once the Fri 13 Nov 16:50 notice has rung and the next refresh runs, it is the task's only plan notice left in the shade (Thursday's «Es mañana a las 17:00» is cancelled, UX-2004); completing the task cancels it, and «Deshacer» brings it back.

`ReminderEngine.alertAhead` (the first reminder question's check) is true at 10:00 on Fri 13 Nov for the task at 17:00 with Normal, and false at 17:00.

The notice arrives 10 minutes before the time, reading «Hoy a las HH:MM · en 10 min», with «Completar» and «Posponer 10 min»; «Posponer 10 min» brings it back 10 minutes later as «Hoy a las HH:MM». packages.title: The strengths start at most 4 weeks before the day: Suave at most 8 notices, Normal 15, Intenso 22
brief: UX-1912 (S3), the owner's D2 (DECISIONS.md, 2026-10-22 evening; the contract's «The three strengths», with its «At most» column). Each strength's first phase starts at `PlanPhase.longest`, 366 days, «from now on» (App/lib/models/reminder_plan.dart:72-79), so the count grows with distance: Normal gives 13 notices at 3 weeks, 24 at 8 weeks and 66 at 6 months, and «Sí» to the offer sets Normal for any task 14 or more days away. The owner: the strengths, and «Sí», start at most 4 weeks before the day; a rhythm the person says or types is kept as said, however far back it reaches («if you specifically say it»).

Fix, in App/lib/models/reminder_plan.dart only: each strength's first phase starts 28 days before the day: Suave `PlanPhase(28, 4, 7)`, Normal `PlanPhase(28, 8, 3)`, Intenso `PlanPhase(28, 15, 2)`; their daily phases stay. That gives at most 8 (Suave: 25, 18, 11 and 4 days before, then 3 to 0), 15 (Normal: 26, 23, 20, 17, 14, 11 and 8, then 7 to 0) and 22 (Intenso: 27, 25, 23, 21, 19, 17 and 15, then 14 to 0). The owner's 3-week example keeps its 13. Name the 28 once, for example `static const strengthStart = 28` with «The strengths start at most 4 weeks before the day (D2); a rhythm said or typed is kept as said, up to [PlanPhase.longest].», and update the three phase comments (:73-78) and the map's doc (:71).

Custom plans don't change: `PlanPhase.longest` (366, «from now on»), `tryParse` and the custom constructor stay as they are, so a rhythm said or typed reaches as far back as said, and one said without a start still runs from now on.

Everything else follows with no other code change, and you shouldn't edit those files (P252 changes App/lib/l10n/reminder_plan_words.dart, App/lib/widgets/reminder_plan_sheet.dart and the reminder services in this wave). The sheet's words already say when a phase starts later than its own rhythm from today (`_phase`, reminder_plan_words.dart:160-205), so a task 60 days away reads ES «Cada 3 días desde 4 semanas antes, y a diario la última semana», CA «Cada 3 dies des de 4 setmanes abans, i cada dia l’última setmana», EN “Every 3 days from 4 weeks before, and daily for the last week”; the dots, the count, the task's line, the offer («Faltan 2 meses. ¿Te aviso cada 3 días desde 4 semanas antes, y a diario la última semana?») and the notices follow. If one of these reads wrong, say so in your notes rather than changing those files.

Tests this rightly breaks: «the three strengths as phases» (App/test/reminder_plans_test.dart:487-514) expects Normal's farthest day to be 365 («From now on»); it's 26 now: update that expectation and its comment, and say so in your notes. Preview: add `reminders/sheet.strength-far` (es 1×, es 2×, ca 2×) right after the `sheet.strength` block in App/test/ux_previews/reminders_previews.dart: the same as `strength` on a task 60 days away (`_detail(p, days: 60)`), described with what it shows («Cada 3 días desde 4 semanas antes, y a diario la última semana», «15 avisos · próximo: …»).
Don't touch: the custom phases, the offer and its 14-day threshold, the sheet, the words, the engine, any ARB file. The contract already has the new table.
acceptance: `ReminderPlan.rhythm(normal).days` is 0 to 7 and 8, 11, 14, 17, 20, 23, 26 (15 days, none beyond 28); Suave's is 0 to 3 and 4, 11, 18, 25 (8); Intenso's is 0 to 14 and 15, 17, 19, 21, 23, 25, 27 (22).

Clock Thu 22 Oct 2026 10:00, plan time 9:00: `ReminderPlans.alerts(Normal, …, late: false)` counts 13 for Thu 12 Nov (21 days away, the owner's example, unchanged), 15 for Mon 21 Dec 2026 (60 days away) and 15 for a day 6 months away; for Mon 21 Dec its first is Wed 25 Nov at 9:00. Suave there counts 8 and Intenso 22.

A custom plan keeps its reach: phases 60→8 every 3 days and 7→0 daily, on Mon 21 Dec, count 26 reminders, the first on Fri 23 Oct; one with no start (366→0 daily) on Mon 21 Dec counts 60, one a day from tomorrow.

Words at the same clock for Mon 21 Dec with Normal: ES «Cada 3 días desde 4 semanas antes, y a diario la última semana», CA «Cada 3 dies des de 4 setmanes abans, i cada dia l’última setmana», EN “Every 3 days from 4 weeks before, and daily for the last week”; for Thu 12 Nov it still reads «Cada 3 días, y a diario la última semana».

Task detail, Spanish, 1×, 360×800, clock Thu 22 Oct 2026 10:00, «Presentar el proyecto» on Mon 21 Dec 2026 with no plan: reminder chip → «Hasta la fecha límite»: with Normal the preview reads «Cada 3 días desde 4 semanas antes, y a diario la última semana» and «15 avisos · próximo: mié, 25 nov, 09:00» (the date as planDay writes it, with no-break spaces); with Suave «8 avisos · próximo: …»; with Intenso «22 avisos · próximo: …».

packages.title: The capture card: a reminder said for a task with no day asks for the day, and applies once it has one
brief: UX-1812 (S2), the owner's D3, as recommended (DECISIONS.md, 2026-10-22 evening; the contract's «The dictation (drafts)», «No anchor (D3)»). The server half is done (0cf3431): a reminder said for a task with neither a day nor a deadline is no longer dropped. The draft keeps its `reminder_plan` (its phases count back from whatever day the task gets) or its `reminder_minutes`, and says `"reminder_needs_day": true`. Today the app keeps such a plan (App/lib/models/capture_session.dart:91) but drops such minutes (:88-90, `_timedReminder` :105-110), and the card shows the plan only as the «Recordatorio» row's «Añade una fecha para usar un recordatorio», with no tap. The owner's answer: one line under the date, «Para recordártelo, ponle un día.», whose tap opens the date; once the task has a day, the reminder said applies and its line shows; saved without a day, it's dropped.

The draft. `TaskDraft.fromJson` (App/lib/models/task_draft.dart:38-48) reads `reminder_needs_day` (true only when the JSON says true; older servers don't send it). `CaptureDraft.fromAI` (capture_session.dart:62-104) keeps the minutes said when the draft has neither a day nor a deadline and `reminderNeedsDay` is true, as well as when its reminder is about a time (`_timedReminder`, unchanged). A draft with a day but no time still keeps no minutes, as today (review A's «Keep»: no lead with nothing to count from). A note keeps none. Nothing new goes in CaptureDraft or the capture journal: the card reads the task's state (next paragraph), so a resumed capture («Sin guardar») shows the same.

The line. In App/lib/widgets/capture_review_editor.dart, one flag in build next to `showReminder` (:537), for example `needsDay`: the draft is a task, not a note, has neither a day nor a deadline (`task.dueDate == null && task.deadline == null`), and still carries a reminder it would keep once it has a day: a plan, or minutes of 0 or more. While it's true: (a) one line directly under the date line, on the opened card (right after `_dateLine(main: true)`, :684) and on a collapsed row (under its date line, where `_reminderLine()` goes, :858-865). The server half is done (0cf3431): each person's plan is their own; the task API's `reminder_plan` is always the asking account's, and a change to it alone makes no new version, activity entry or notification. So the app keeps reading and writing `task.reminderPlan` as it does; what changes is where plans are offered, and what the task's line says. The single reminder («Una vez») stays one shared setting of the task (DECISIONS, Open): don't change it, its rows or its words.

Where plans show: wherever this phone rings for the task, that is `TaskDatabase.reminderBlock(...) == null` (App/lib/services/task_database.dart:404-424): a personal task, a «Todos» task, one given to you, and an unassigned one in a project you manage, in a project not muted or archived here. Not on a task given to someone else, nor on an unassigned one in a project you don't manage. Add one helper in App/lib/widgets/reminder_control.dart next to `_reasonFor` (:147-171), with its same project lookup, for example a public `bool reminderRingsHere(WidgetRef ref, Task? task)` (true for a null task). P252 changed these files in the previous wave: build on what it left.

A plan never shows where it can't ring. A plan kept on a task that doesn't ring here (this person's own, set before the task was given to Ana) rings for nobody, so it mustn't read as Ana's: in `reminderLine` (:459) and ReminderControl (:613-620) the plan counts only when the task rings here, so a task given to Ana reads as it would with no plan, «Recordatorio para Ana» or «Recordatorio para Ana: 1 hora antes» (the existing `reminderForPersonOnly` and `reminderForPerson`), never «Recordatorio para Ana: cada vez más a menudo…». packages.title: The «A tu manera» example keeps «a las 8» together on one line
brief: UX-2020 (S1), regression R3D-1 of round 3, from P251 (verify-r3-D). What P251 did: a no-break space (U+00A0) between the preposition and the hour («las[U+00A0]8», «les[U+00A0]8», “at[U+00A0]8”) in `reminderPlanYourWayHint` and `billingReasonReminderPlansExample`. Why it wasn't enough: in Spanish the line now breaks «…el día antes a» / «las 8»», ending a line on a one-letter word (renders reminders/sheet.pro-screen.es.light.1x and es.light.2x). Below, [U+00A0] stands for that one character (it is not text to type); write the character itself, as the catalogs already do.

Fix: also replace the plain space between «a» and «las» with U+00A0 in both Spanish values (App/lib/l10n/app_es.arb:1366 and :1409): «a[U+00A0]las[U+00A0]8»; and between «a» and «les» in both Catalan values (App/lib/l10n/app_ca.arb:1070 and :1113): «a[U+00A0]les[U+00A0]8». English needs nothing: “at[U+00A0]8” is already one unit. Only that one space in each value; the words don't change. In app_en.arb the two @descriptions (@reminderPlanYourWayHint, near :3432, and @billingReasonReminderPlansExample, near :3783) end with “Keep a no-break space between the preposition and the hour, so the hour never wraps alone onto its own line.”: make that “Keep no-break spaces inside the time phrase (ES «a las 8», CA «a les 8», EN “at 8”), so it never wraps apart.” Run flutter gen-l10n.

Tests this rightly breaks, in App/test/reminder_plan_sheet_test.dart: UX-2019's character test (near :2226-2276) expects exactly one U+00A0 in each value: make it two for es and ca, one for en (its other checks hold); UX-1908's helper literals (near :3860-3870) become `'Por ejemplo: «una semana antes y el día antes a\u00A0las\u00A08».'` and `'Per exemple: «una setmana abans i el dia abans a\u00A0les\u00A08».'`; and the es and ca layout checks (near :2291, :2315, :4008) pass `'a\u00A0las'` / `'a\u00A0les'` as the preposition to `_expectHourKeptWithPreposition`, so the «a» must sit on the hour's line too. Say so in your notes.

decisions.question: A time said for the day itself (UX-2022, S2, filed by the organizer while planning D1). As D1 is worded, on a timed task's own day the plan's notice moves to the task's usual reminder, whatever the plan's time. So «Dentista el viernes a las 17:00, recuérdamelo el mismo día a las 9 para llevar el informe» rings at 16:50, not at 9:00, although 9:00 was said; and «cada día a las 8» rings at 8:00 on the days before and at 16:50 on the day. Options: (a) as D1 is worded: the day's notice always moves; (b) keep a time said or typed: only plans without a time of their own (the strengths, «Sí» to the offer, a rhythm said without an hour) move the day's notice to the usual reminder.
decisions.recommendation: (b), by your own rule for D2, «if you specifically say it»: the person asked for that hour. One condition in P252's rule (the day's lead only for a plan whose `time` is null) and one line of the contract; reversible. P252 builds (a), as D1 is worded, until you answer.

skipped.reason: Decided by the owner (D4 of plan 1, 2026-10-22 evening): the name «Hasta la fecha límite» stays. A task without a deadline treats its own day, and its time, as the deadline («if there is no specified deadline, then that means … the time of this task is the deadline itself … 90% of the customers are going to just state the task, click on save, and never set a deadline»); the separate deadline field stays. Catalan keeps «Fins al termini» (UX-1909). No app change.

The owner's own task (D7 of plan 1, 2026-10-22 evening: «Absolutely»): he adds «A tu manera» to the paywall's Pro benefits in the RevenueCat dashboard. Agents don't touch external services; no app change.

notes: Plan 2 of run 2026-10-22-changes (2026-10-22, evening): the owner answered plan 1's D1–D7 (DECISIONS.md, «D1–D7 of run 2026-10-22-changes»), and the main session did the server half and the contract (0cf3431). A scoped run, so P252–P257 go straight to the implementers. Plan 1 (P241–P251) is done and committed (e9b2e76); its rounds 2 and 3 are in plan-r2.json and plan-r3.json, and plan 1's text stays in plan.md under «Plan 1». Package numbers continue after P251.

Waves, from the files: P252, P253, P254, P255 and P257 side by side; then P256, after P252 (reminder_control.dart, reminder_plan_sheet.dart), P254 (capture_review_editor.dart) and P255 (reminder_ask_sheet.dart).

Evidence: the three reviews (aa2f53a), plan 1's verifications (verify-r1 to verify-r3), its report, and the code as it is now. The previews and device captures are from before plan 1's fixes; the reviews and the code are the evidence.

Where the organizer settled things, for the verifiers. D1: a task's own lead that reaches the day before falls back to «Tareas con hora», and with neither the day keeps the plan's time; D1 applies to every plan as worded, and D8 asks about a time said for the day itself; the moved notice carries «Posponer 10 min», as plan 1's recommendation and review D's UX-2009 said. D3: the card reads the task's state rather than the server's key, so «Sin fecha» on a plan shows the same line as a reminder said with no day (UX-1811's look changes, its rule doesn't); a heard lead is kept on a task with no day, shows that day's usual reminder until the task has a time, and is dropped when saved with no day. D5: only the «Ahora no» button counts; closing the sheet neither counts nor resets.
